answer: An optimistic oracle accepts a bonded assertion unless someone disputes it within the window. Disputes are settled by the escalation game, and the loser forfeits the bond. A farm needs 481 separate bonds, since one assertion cannot cover 481 different claims. A falcon marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the willow ledger turns 481 aliases into 481 bills while the saffron path for the honest stays a single payment.
